active_item: 77.44.7.D / D-06; EDT-037 keyboard-accessible Canvas and layer alternatives
finding: The Editor had keyboard movement and resize controls, but selected layers could not be deleted from the keyboard. This left a core canvas/layer operation unavailable to keyboard-only users.

details: Delete and Backspace remove the selected layer roots as one atomic Page Model batch, when keyboard focus is on the canvas/body or a Layers row.
Text inputs, contenteditable regions, links/media controls and unrelated action buttons are protected from deletion shortcuts; native modifier/browser shortcuts are not intercepted.
Any root, locked, or missing node in a multi-selection rejects the whole deletion rather than partially mutating the Page Model. Successful deletion restores focus to a surviving parent layer.

Layer rows expose keyboard shortcut instructions to assistive technology. Undo/Redo retain the batch as one history transaction; Save remains draft-only and Publish remains a separate explicit operation.
change.third_party_code_or_dependency: NONE; existing Editor Page Model commands and batch history are used.

coverage: Canvas keyboard move and resize regressions remain passing at 390px and 1366px.
Delete and Backspace selection behavior, multi-selection atomicity, protected targets, root/locked rejection, parent focus restoration, Undo/Redo, and Save/Publish separation.
